options.option: Reject the edit and surface a sync conflict
options.tradeoff: Safest against silent data resurrection, but requires a visible conflict/recovery path for the user.

options.option: Apply the edit and recreate the record
options.tradeoff: Maximizes automatic recovery of offline work, but may silently resurrect records intentionally deleted on the server.

options.option: Pause replay and require manual resolution
options.tradeoff: Avoids automatic data loss or resurrection, but blocks the remaining queue until a resolver acts.

summary.affected: Clients reconnecting with one or more queued offline edits.
summary.changed_feature: Reconnect synchronization replays offline.edits through models/record.py.
summary.possible_issue: Edits may be skipped, duplicated, reordered, or bypass normal updated_at stamping during reconnect.
summary.prevention: Drain a stable queue snapshot exactly once in local creation order and invoke the record-processing entry point for every edit before acknowledging/removing it.
summary.trigger: Connectivity returns while client/queue.py contains offline.edits.

summary.affected: Offline clients reconnecting more than 24 hours after a server-side deletion.
summary.changed_feature: Reconnect synchronization may replay edits created while a record was deleted on the server.
summary.possible_issue: After the 24-hour tombstone expires, replay cannot reliably distinguish an update from unintended resurrection of a deleted record.
summary.prevention: Select and test an explicit stale-delete conflict policy before enabling automatic replay.
summary.trigger: A queued edit targets a record whose deletion tombstone is no longer retained.

summary.affected: Records edited both offline and on the server before reconnect.
summary.changed_feature: Offline edits receive updated_at values during reconnect replay.
summary.possible_issue: Replay-time timestamps can make old offline changes appear newer than intervening server changes, causing last-write-wins conflicts.
summary.prevention: Keep deterministic queue order and define conflict comparison using explicit edit metadata or a documented replay policy rather than assuming updated_at reflects original edit time.
summary.trigger: A queued offline edit and a server-side mutation affect the same record.

unresolved.rationale: The repository evidence does not define whether an edit after tombstone expiry should be rejected, recreated, or manually resolved.
